content.title: Submit a Crime Tip
content.summary: Individuals with information about a crime can submit anonymous tips to assist investigators without revealing their identity. For emergencies, it is advised to call 911, and for jurisdiction inquiries, contact 303-980-7300. Tips can be submitted through a designated online platform, ensuring confidentiality for the informant.
content.body:
If you require immediate attention for an emergency, **please dial 911**. If you are not certain of jurisdiction, please call 303-980-7300 before completing this report.

People with vital information about a crime usually won't contact police because they fear retaliation or because they do not want to end up in court as a witness. Crime tips are very valuable to investigators and can be used without exposing the source of information if the person wishes to remain anonymous.

[Submit an anonymous tip](https://www.metrodenvercrimestoppers.com/submit-a-tip). Your comments and personal information, if submitted, will remain confidential.
